Terminal: owned emulation state (src/terminal/Terminal.zig)
|
|-- rows / cols / pixel dimensions / scrolling_region / tabstops
|-- modes / colors / title / pwd / dirty flags
|-- cursor: shared appearance defaults (not screen position)
`-- screens: ScreenSet (src/terminal/ScreenSet.zig)
    |-- active_key + active: alias into all, not another Screen
    |-- generations: detects removed/replaced screen storage
    `-- all: owned primary Screen (eager) + alternate Screen (lazy)
        `-- Screen (src/terminal/Screen.zig)
            |-- cursor / saved_cursor: screen position, pen, wrap state
            |   `-- cursor.page_pin / page_row / page_cell -> pages
            |-- selection: tracked endpoints -> pages.tracked_pins
            |-- charset / protected_mode / kitty_keyboard
            |-- kitty_images (when enabled) / semantic_prompt / dirty
            `-- pages: PageList (src/terminal/PageList.zig)
                |-- pool + limits + desired rows/cols + total_rows
                |-- viewport + viewport_pin; tracked_pins: PinSet
                |   `-- Cursor / selection / viewport locations track edits
                `-- pages: ordered doubly-linked nodes, history -> active
                    `-- Node: links / serial / allocation ownership
                        `-- data: resident Page OR compressed page
                            |-- Compressed: encoded copy; retains Page virtual mapping
                            `-- Page metadata/backing (src/terminal/page.zig)
                                |-- memory: contiguous page-aligned backing
                                |-- rows: ordered Row metadata -> cell offsets
                                |-- cells: column-ordered within each row
                                |-- grapheme allocator + cell-to-grapheme map
                                |-- styles + hyperlink map/set + string allocator
                                `-- size / capacity / dirty
